name: Pecharunt
author: IKEDA Saki
flavor_text: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

abilities.name: Final Chain
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Mochi Rush
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon’s Mochi Rush attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
